answer_1.quote: We improve the idiomatic translations generated by a strong pretrained machine translation model, ∆LM , without harming the translation quality of literal expressions.

answer_2.quote: We use multiple automatic metrics to evaluate translation quality.

answer_4.quote: Due to the importance of accurate semantic evaluation, the authors (native English speakers and fluent in French and Japanese) conduct a human evaluation inspired by MQM.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluation standards were based on MQM standards, in particular the major and critical severity levels.
